📢FINAL ANNOUNCEMENT

💌The House of Creed Pop Up Event with GEMINI

Mark your calendars for both AUGUST 8 AND AUGUST 9, 2025!

Here’s a breakdown of the updated schedule and essential guidelines:

August 8: This day is an exclusive event held in partnership with Tatler Philippines. Fans will have the chance to catch a glimpse of Gemini.

August 9: This day is an exclusive event held in partnership with invited media. Fans will still have the chance to catch a glimpse of Gemini.

BOTH DAYS, we’ll see GEMINI NORAWIT. 😊

Crucial Guidelines & Reminders for Both Days:

• NO SEAT RESERVATIONS ARE ALLOWED.
• To ensure everyone’s safety and maintain order, please avoid bringing heavy meals such as rice (snacks are allowed) or setting up anything that might cause commotion or crowding.
• We kindly request your cooperation in keeping the area safe and tidy.
• We request everyone not to loiter in the area and keep the noise down as a mass is held at 6PM-7PM every Friday at the Chapel within the vicinity.
• We request everyone to join the trending of the official hashtag on both days. Kindly use (hashtag from organizer)

Here’s the HTs

#/TheHouseOfCreed
#/CreedClassics
#/CreedPHxGemini

Note: This is a highly exclusive event. Your cooperation ensures a smooth and enjoyable experience for everyone. Let’s make both days memorable for Gemini!

Schedules: 
August 8, 2025 (Friday) - 5:30PM 
August 9, 2025 (Saturday) -3:00PM

We highly encourage the fans who are planning to see Gemini to come earlier before the stated time to secure your spots.

#Gemini_NT #เจมีไนน์ @gemini_nt
